questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All hotels are restaurants.

All restaurants are cafes.

Some restaurants are kitchens.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some cafes are kitchens.

(II) Some hotels are kitchens.
questions.solution:
Statements:

All hotels are restaurants.

All restaurants are cafes.

Some restaurants are kitchens.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6531f58aaf689aa12c22c72897a5ae4951eae69ff76771f42cc1d5f412d8bff6.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some cafes are kitchens. - Follow (Because, All restaurants are cafes and Some restaurants are kitchens, which means Some cafes are kitchens.)

(II) Some hotels are kitchens. - Does not follow (There is no definite relation between hotels and kitchens, it can be possible but it is not definite.)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Dhanya starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards south. She then takes a left turn, drives 11 km, turns left and drives 2 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 4 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
Given:

Dhanya starts from Point A and drives 9 km South.

Turns left and drives 11 km (East), then turns left and drives 2 km (North).

Turns left and drives 4 km (West), then takes a final right turn and drives 7 km (North) to reach Point P.

 
 North 
• 
• South West 
• 
• East 
• 
• Point A 
• 9 km 
• 11 km 
• 2 km 
• 4 km 
• 7 km Point P 
• (7 km to reach A) 
 

Calculating vertical position: Total South = 9 km. Total North = 2 km + 7 km = 9 km. Therefore, Point P is on the same horizontal level as Point A.

Calculating horizontal position: East = 11 km. West = 4 km. Net distance from A = $11 - 4 = 7$ km East.

To reach Point A from Point P, she must drive **7 km towards the West**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

questions.question: Six people, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a straight line facing towards north. N is sitting at the leftmost end of the row. Only 3 people are sitting between N and Q. L is sitting second right to P. M is sitting second right to L. Based on the given arrangement three of the following four are alike, find the odd one out?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six people, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a straight line facing towards north.

1. N is sitting at the leftmost end of the row.

2. Only 3 people are sitting between N and Q.

3. L is sitting second right to P.

4. M is sitting second right to L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4d2ee7de4ddf4cbf1d53425d027f6d19f64f83d9b3f963270efc6d93229e09a.png] 

O, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591b6bed7ae11faa82ec0aefba7d9b2bae6f6e52d3592c85b29111f9714c7660.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. OP → No one is sitting between O and P. 

2. LM → One person is sitting between L and M. 

3. PL → One person is sitting between P and L.

4. NO → One person is sitting between N and O.

Thus, OP is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
